name: MonarchCallTile
title: CallTile
wrapsNative: A SwiftUI Layout at 16 by 9 with the video slot (any View, such as a UIViewRepresentable around the call SDK's renderer) or MonarchAvatar in the background, overlays for the name bar, MonarchBadge hand, Buttons, and TimelineView(.explicit) for the reaction
summary: One participant in a call: their video or avatar, name, muted microphone, raised hand, status, connection quality and floating reactions, with Pin and full-screen buttons.
whenToUse: In the grid, the filmstrip or the main spot of a video call, one tile per participant, fed by the product's call SDK.
whenNotToUse: Not for a shared screen with zoom and pan; use MonarchScreenShareView. Not for the call's own controls; use MonarchCallControls.
api: init(_ name: String, isPinned: Binding<Bool>? = nil, avatarURL: URL? = nil, showsVideo: Bool = true, isSelf: Bool = false, isMicOff: Bool = false, isSpeaking: Bool = false, isHandRaised: Bool = false, isScreen: Bool = false, status: String? = nil, statusTone: MonarchTone = .neutral, quality: MonarchCallQuality? = nil, reaction: MonarchCallReaction? = nil, size: MonarchCallTileSize = .md, labels: MonarchCallTileLabels = MonarchCallTileLabels(), onFullScreen: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder video: () -> Video)

init(_ name: String, isPinned: Binding<Bool>? = nil, avatarURL: URL? = nil, isSelf: Bool = false, isMicOff: Bool = false, isSpeaking: Bool = false, isHandRaised: Bool = false, status: String? = nil, statusTone: MonarchTone = .neutral, quality: MonarchCallQuality? = nil, reaction: MonarchCallReaction? = nil, size: MonarchCallTileSize = .md, labels: MonarchCallTileLabels = MonarchCallTileLabels(), onFullScreen: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil) where Video == EmptyView

enum MonarchCallTileSize { case sm, md, lg }

options.name: name
options.description: The participant's display name; names the tile and its buttons.

options.name: isPinned
options.description: Whether the participant is pinned to the main spot. Adds a Pin or Unpin button that toggles it.

options.name: showsVideo
options.description: Whether the video slot is shown; false shows the avatar while connecting or with the camera off.

options.name: isSelf
options.description: This is you: adds "(you)" and mirrors the video.

options.name: isSpeaking
options.description: Draws a 2-point accent border around the tile.

options.name: isHandRaised
options.description: Shows a warning badge with a hand and "Hand raised".

options.name: isScreen
options.description: The video is a shared screen: never mirrored, and the screen symbol is shown.

options.name: status
options.description: A short status in the name bar, such as "Reconnecting…" or "Presenting".

options.name: statusTone
options.description: The colour of the status on the inverse name bar.

options.name: quality
options.description: Three, two or one lit signal bars. None when nil.

options.name: reaction
options.description: An emoji that floats up for three seconds after sentAt and is announced.

options.name: size
options.description: sm for the filmstrip (smaller avatar and text, no buttons), md in a grid, lg for the main speaker.

options.name: onFullScreen
options.description: Shows the participant full screen. Adds the button; the product presents the full-screen view.

options.name: video
options.description: The participant's video from the product's call SDK.

states.name: avatar
states.description: Without video the avatar is centred on the emphasis background.

states.name: video
states.description: The slot fills the tile, mirrored for your own camera.

states.name: muted
states.description: A crossed-out microphone in the name bar.

states.name: hand raised
states.description: A solid warning badge with a hand at the top leading corner.

states.name: pinned
states.description: The Pin button becomes Unpin with a crossed-out pin, and has the selected trait.

states.name: reaction
states.description: The emoji rises and fades in, stays for three seconds, then fades; it only fades with Reduce Motion.

states.name: poor connection
states.description: One lit bar of three and the spoken name "Poor connection".

appearance: The tile on the emphasis background with large rounded corners; the name bar and the action buttons on the inverse background with inverse text; status text in the tone's strong inverse colour; the speaking border in the accent solid colour. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web tile renders a MediaStream in a video element and offers the Fullscreen API; on iOS the video is a slot for the call SDK's own view, and full screen is the product's presentation through onFullScreen. Pinned is a binding instead of pinned and onPinnedChange. Reactions carry a Date and are timed with TimelineView, so no timer runs and tests inject the time. The avatar is 40 points at most, the largest MonarchAvatar size, where the web uses its extra-large avatar. Hover-only actions are always visible on touch screens.
accessibility: The tile is a container named by the participant; its name bar is one element read first, named "Ana (you)", with a value listing what is true now: "Speaking, Muted, Hand raised, Sharing screen, Presenting, Poor connection".
Speaking is also a thicker border, muted and the hand are symbols, and quality is the number of lit bars, so nothing depends on colour.
Pin and full screen are buttons named "Pin Ana", "Unpin Ana" and "Show Ana full screen", with 44-point touch targets; Pin has the toggle trait and the selected trait when pinned.
A new reaction is announced as "Ana reacted 👏"; the floating emoji itself is hidden.
The video and the avatar are hidden from VoiceOver.
The reaction stands still with Reduce Motion, and the tile grows taller at large text sizes.
edgeCases: A reaction with a sentAt in the future or more than three seconds ago is not shown.
Sending the same reaction again with a new sentAt replays it.
A long name or status wraps in the name bar and makes the tile taller instead of being cut.
With showsVideo false the slot is not drawn, so a frozen frame never shows.
